scripts.text:
[Mariner]
This ship
is heading
towards ^666699Izlude^000000.
Have you enjoyed your time in Jawaii? You should check to see
if you forgot anything before we go.
scripts.translation:
[水手]
这艘船
正驶向^666699依斯鲁得岛^000000。
你在爪哇玩得开心吗？出发前最好检查一下有没有落下什么东西。

scripts.text:
[Mariner]
Well, then.
Would you like
to go back to Izlude?
scripts.translation:
[水手]
那么，
你想返回
依斯鲁得岛吗？

scripts.text: Go back.
scripts.translation: 回去。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消。

scripts.text:
[Mariner]
Now, let me
guide you to
Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[水手]
现在，让我
带你去
依斯鲁得岛。

scripts.text:
[Mariner]
Take your time
and look around as
much as you like.
Somehow,  this is not
a place that you can
visit often, you know?
scripts.translation:
[水手]
慢慢来，
尽情四处看看。
毕竟，这里可不是
你能经常来的地方，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Mariner]
This ship
is headed back
towards ^003399Alberta^000000.
Have you enjoyed your time in Jawaii? You should check to see
if you forgot anything before we go.
scripts.translation:
[水手]
这艘船
正返回^003399艾尔贝塔^000000。
你在爪哇玩得开心吗？出发前最好检查一下有没有落下什么东西。

scripts.text:
[Mariner]
Now, are you
ready to go back
to Alberta?
scripts.translation:
[水手]
那么，你
准备好返回
艾尔贝塔了吗？

scripts.text: Go back.
scripts.translation: 回去。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消。

scripts.text:
[Mariner]
Now, let me
take you back
to Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[水手]
现在，让我
带你回
艾尔贝塔。

scripts.text:
[Mariner]
Yeah...
Try to enjoy your
vacation as much
as you can. We'll be
ready to leave when
you are.
scripts.translation:
[水手]
是啊……
尽量享受你的
假期吧。等你准备好了，
我们就出发。

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Oh, dear!
You're not going
to the tavern, are you?
scripts.translation:
[女士]
哎呀！
你不是要去
酒馆吧？

scripts.text: No, I am not.
scripts.translation: 不，我不去。

scripts.text: Hell yeah~
scripts.translation: 当然要去~

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Whew~!
Thank goodness!
It's just that...
The tavern probably
isn't the best place for
you to enjoy yourself.
scripts.translation:
[女士]
呼~！
谢天谢地！
只是……
酒馆可能不是
让你玩得开心的
好地方。

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Even though I work there, I still can't believe that kind of place exists! I mean, I thought alcohol was outlawed in the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom!
scripts.translation:
[女士]
虽然我在那里工作，但我还是无法相信那种地方竟然存在！我是说，我以为酒精在卢恩·米德加兹王国是被禁止的！

scripts.text:
[Lady]
I have no idea how singles are
able to find this place. But I've heard that lots of different people come here for different reasons.
scripts.translation:
[女士]
我不知道单身人士是怎么
找到这个地方的。但我听说
很多人出于不同的原因来到这里。

scripts.text:
[Lady]
I've even seen unmarried single people coming here just to get drunk! Oh! And for some reason, people have been disappearing
from the tavern!
scripts.translation:
[女士]
我甚至看到未婚的单身人士来这里只是为了喝醉！哦！而且不知为何，有人从酒馆里失踪了！

scripts.text:
[Lady]
I wonder what's going on?
^666666*Sigh*^000000 I'm a waitress there, but still I just want to tell you not to go in there...
scripts.translation:
[女士]
不知道发生了什么事？
^666666*叹气*^000000 我虽然是那里的女服务员，但还是想劝你别进去……

scripts.text:
[Jawa Jawa]
You know what's
the most beautiful
place in Jawaii?
scripts.translation:
[爪哇爪哇]
你知道爪哇
最美的
地方在哪里吗？

scripts.text:
[Jawa Jawa]
It's 'Heart Island,' which is just a little north of here. The water surrounding Heart Island is not that deep, so you can just walk across if you're careful.
scripts.translation:
[爪哇爪哇]
是‘心形岛’，就在北边一点。心形岛周围的水并不深，只要小心点，你可以直接走过去。

scripts.text:
[Jawa Jawa]
That's the best place to share an intimate moment with the person
you love. It's perfectly secluded and such a beautiful area.
scripts.translation:
[爪哇爪哇]
那是和你爱的人共度亲密时光的最佳地点。那里非常隐蔽，景色也很美。

scripts.text:
[Jawa Jawa]
Of course, it's probably not
a good idea to go there by
yourself if you're single.
You'd look like such
a pathetic loser!
scripts.translation:
[爪哇爪哇]
当然，如果你是单身，独自去那里可能不是个好主意。
那样看起来像个可怜的失败者！

scripts.text:
[Waii Waii]
Welcome to Jawaii!
scripts.translation:
[怀怀]
欢迎来到爪哇！

scripts.text:
[Waii Waii]
Here, you can enjoy your
honeymoon without worrying about any interruptions. You don't even have to bother with that notorious Single Army!
scripts.translation:
[怀怀]
在这里，你可以享受蜜月，不用担心被打扰。你甚至不必理会那个臭名昭著的单身军团！

scripts.text:
[Waii Waii]
Well, there are a few monsters around, but you'll be okay as long as you don't attack them first. Think of them as the original residents of this island, another sight to enjoy.
scripts.translation:
[怀怀]
嗯，周围有一些魔物，但只要你不先攻击它们，你就没事。把它们当作这个岛的原住民，也是另一道风景。

scripts.text:
[Waja Waja]
Ah, you must be a tourist.
If you're lost, just head West. Accommodations for newlyweds
are located in the western part of Jawaii. The lodging here is
pretty amazing.
scripts.translation:
[瓦贾瓦贾]
啊，你一定是游客。
如果你迷路了，就往西走。新婚夫妇的住宿设施位于爪哇的西部。这里的住宿相当棒。

scripts.text:
[Waja Waja]
There are four different themed rooms, so you can choose one to your liking. There's a Guide around if you want to ask for more information.
scripts.translation:
[瓦贾瓦贾]
这里有四种不同主题的房间，你可以根据自己的喜好选择。如果你想了解更多信息，附近有一位向导。

scripts.text:
[Waja Waja]
When you want to go back, please head to the NorthWest to board
a ship to Alberta. If you want to sail to Izlude, there's a ship waiting in the SouthEast.
scripts.translation:
[瓦贾瓦贾]
当你想回去时，请前往西北方向乘坐前往艾尔贝塔的船。如果你想航行到依斯鲁得岛，东南方向有一艘船在等候。

scripts.text:
[Iwa Iwa]
Jawaii~
Jawa~ii~
Where you can
find happiness~
scripts.translation:
[伊瓦伊瓦]
爪哇~
爪~哇~
幸福之地~

scripts.text:
[Iwa Iwa]
Oh, isn't it beautiful? You don't have to do anything other than relax and breathe in the peaceful atmosphere. That's one of the
best things about Jawaii.
scripts.translation:
[伊瓦伊瓦]
哦，不是很美吗？你只需要放松身心，呼吸这宁静的空气。这就是爪哇最棒的地方之一。

scripts.text:
[Iwa Iwa]
Ooh! Sometimes we hold
concerts on this stage. If you're good at singing, why don't you
go up on stage and sing
a song for us?
scripts.translation:
[伊瓦伊瓦]
噢！我们有时在这个舞台上举办音乐会。如果你擅长唱歌，为什么不走上舞台为我们唱一首歌呢？

scripts.text:
[Iwa Iwa]
Jawaii~
Jawa~ii~
Where you can
find happiness~
scripts.translation:
[伊瓦伊瓦]
爪哇~
爪~哇~
幸福之地~

scripts.text:
[Alowa]
W-Welcome...?
This is o-o-our
s-sweet room.
We, we just c-cleaned
this r-room for you
o-of course.
scripts.translation:
[阿洛瓦]
欢-欢迎……？
这是俺-俺们
的甜-甜蜜房间。
俺-俺们刚-刚为你
打-打扫了这个房-房间
当-当然啦。

scripts.text:
[Alowa]
Th-The charge is is
1000 zeny p-p-per person?
P-please pay me the fee and
I,I'll let you in. I ssss...swear!
scripts.translation:
[阿洛瓦]
费-费用是每人1000泽尼？
请-请付钱，然-然后我，我让你进去。我发-发誓！

scripts.text:
[Alowa]
I, I'll also ca-carry your luggage. B-but pay me first. Otherwise, my bo-boss will be unhappy and... ^666666*Gulp*^000000
scripts.translation:
[阿洛瓦]
我，我也帮-帮你拿行李。但-但是先付钱。否则，老-老板会不高兴，然后…… ^666666*吞口水*^000000

scripts.text:
[Alowa]
^333333Beat me to death...^000000
Use.
scripts.translation: 使用。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消。

scripts.text:
[Alowa]
T-Thank you ssso much!
L-Let open the room door
ffffor you. Thank y-you.
Ha-have a good time.
scripts.translation:
[阿洛瓦]
非-非常感谢！
我-我来为你开-开门。谢-谢谢你。
祝-祝你玩得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Alowa]
Oh no! Oh no no no no no.
Th-This isn't enough money?
I-I'm ssssorry, but my b-boss w-will beat me if I l-let you
in without paying...
scripts.translation:
[阿洛瓦]
哦不！哦不不不不不。
这-这点钱不够？
对-对不起，但如果我不收钱就让你进去，老-老板会打我的……

scripts.text:
[Alowa]
^666666*Sniff*^000000
B-but I promise th-that this room is the nicest and cl-cleanest room! P-Please! C-come back!
scripts.translation:
[阿洛瓦]
^666666*抽泣*^000000
但-但我保证这个房间是最-最好、最干-干净的！求-求你了！再-再来吧！

scripts.text:
[Pine Oran]
Welcome to
the Antique room.
scripts.translation:
[派恩·奥兰]
欢迎来到
古董房。

scripts.text:
[Pine Oran]
This room provides lovers with
an atmosphere of plush elegance.
Every comfort is provided for
young couples in this room.
scripts.translation:
[派恩·奥兰]
这个房间为恋人提供奢华优雅的氛围。年轻情侣在这个房间里可以享受所有的舒适。

scripts.text:
[Pine Oran]
All the rooms may have the same basic structure, but each of them has their own unique interior to suit the tastes of different people.
scripts.translation:
[派恩·奥兰]
所有房间的基本结构可能相同，但每个房间都有独特的内部装饰，以适应不同人的品味。

scripts.text:
[Pine Oran]
If you would like to lodge here, it is required to pay a 1,000 zeny fee for each person before entering. Since you're here to make fond memories of your honeymoon,
you should stay in the nicest room.
scripts.translation:
[派恩·奥兰]
如果你想在这里住宿，进入前需要每人支付1000泽尼的费用。既然你是来创造美好的蜜月回忆，你应该住在最好的房间里。

scripts.text:
[Pine Oran]
Do not hesitate to let me know when you've decided on the Antique Room. Once you've made your choice,
I will guide you there.
scripts.translation:
[派恩·奥兰]
当你决定选择古董房时，请告诉我。一旦你做出选择，我会带你去那里。

scripts.text: Use.
scripts.translation: 使用。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消。

scripts.text:
[Pine Oran]
Thank you
for using
our services.
Please...
Make yourself
comfortable.
scripts.translation:
[派恩·奥兰]
感谢你
使用
我们的服务。
请……
随意放松。

scripts.text:
[Pine Oran]
I am sorry, but you don't seem to have enough money. If it's alright, why don't you check your current funds and see what you can do
about this situation?
scripts.translation:
[派恩·奥兰]
很抱歉，你似乎没有足够的钱。如果可以的话，为什么不检查一下你目前的资金，看看能做什么来解决这个问题？

scripts.text:
[Pine Oran]
Please...
Take your time.
There should be no rush
when it comes to leisure.
scripts.translation:
[派恩·奥兰]
请……
慢慢来。
休闲的时候
不必匆忙。

scripts.text:
[Sharkie Rania]
I'll take you
to the Honey Room.
It costs 1,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[沙基·拉尼娅]
我带你去
蜂蜜房。
费用是1000泽尼。

scripts.text:
[Sharkie Rania]
So you wanna go?
scripts.translation:
[沙基·拉尼娅]
所以你想去吗？

scripts.text: Use.
scripts.translation: 使用。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消。

scripts.text:
[Sharkie Rania]
Eh, alright.
Let's get going.
scripts.translation:
[沙基·拉尼娅]
呃，好吧。
我们走吧。

scripts.text:
[Sharkie Rania]
You...
Don't have
enough money.
C'mon, romance
takes zeny, got it?
scripts.translation:
[沙基·拉尼娅]
你……
没有
足够的钱。
拜托，浪漫需要泽尼，懂吗？

scripts.text:
[Sharkie Rania]
No prob.
scripts.translation:
[沙基·拉尼娅]
没问题。

scripts.text:
[Larks Rania]
Hello dear,
how are you?
Are you looking for
a room to stay in?
scripts.translation:
[拉克斯·拉尼娅]
你好亲爱的，
你好吗？
你在找
住宿的房间吗？

scripts.text:
[Larks Rania]
This is called the Villa Room.
I recommend this room to people
who prefer to stay in a place with
a comfortable atmosphere
much like home.
scripts.translation:
[拉克斯·拉尼娅]
这叫别墅房。
我推荐给那些喜欢待在像家一样舒适氛围中的人。

scripts.text:
[Larks Rania]
Just like all the other rooms,
the lodging charge is 1,000 zeny.
I can guide you to the Villa Room
right now, if you wish. Would you
like to stay?
scripts.translation:
[拉克斯·拉尼娅]
就像其他房间一样，住宿费是1000泽尼。如果你愿意，我现在可以带你去别墅房。你想住吗？

scripts.text: Use.
scripts.translation: 使用。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消。

scripts.text:
[Larks Rania]
Thank you~
Enjoy your stay.
scripts.translation:
[拉克斯·拉尼娅]
谢谢~
祝你入住愉快。

scripts.text:
[Larks Rania]
Oh what a shame!
You don't seem
to have enough money...?
Why don't you ask your
partner to help you
with the charge?
scripts.translation:
[拉克斯·拉尼娅]
哦真可惜！
你似乎
没有足够的钱……？
为什么不让你的伴侣
帮你支付费用呢？

scripts.text:
[Larks Rania]
No problem~
If you like, you may wish to check the Honey Room. Although the roomkeeper, Sharkie, is a shy girl, the room is really beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[拉克斯·拉尼娅]
没问题~
如果你喜欢，你可以去看看蜂蜜房。虽然房间管理员沙基是个害羞的女孩，但房间真的很漂亮。

scripts.text:
[Helper]
There is no place
better for having your
honeymoon than Jawaii.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
没有比爪哇更适合度蜜月的地方了。

scripts.text:
[Helper]
Why don't you make the best of your time here, and make a lot of sweet memories that you will cherish for years to come?
scripts.translation:
[助手]
为什么不充分利用这里的时间，创造许多你会珍藏多年的甜蜜回忆呢？

scripts.text:
[Helper]
Mementos that remind you of your happy times can be your most precious possessions. Like your wedding ring, for instance, or the tuxedo and wedding dress worn during your wedding ceremony...
scripts.translation:
[助手]
提醒你快乐时光的纪念品可能是你最珍贵的财产。比如你的结婚戒指，或者婚礼仪式上穿的燕尾服和结婚礼服……

scripts.text:
[Helper]
Even if the wedding ceremony
is over, isn't it nice to look back upon the happy memories of your marriage ceremony? With the magical photo album at a cheap price, now you can!
scripts.translation:
[助手]
即使婚礼已经结束，回顾婚礼的快乐回忆不是很好吗？有了这本便宜的魔法相册，现在你可以做到了！

scripts.text:
[Helper]
Its name is...
'Sweet Memory of Marriage'!!
scripts.translation:
[助手]
它的名字是……
‘甜蜜婚姻记忆’！！

scripts.text:
[Helper]
It will instantly bring you to the wedding hall with magic power!
And it only costs 50,000 zeny...
scripts.translation:
[助手]
它会用魔法力量瞬间把你带到婚礼大厅！
而且只需50,000泽尼……

scripts.text: I shall buy it.
scripts.translation: 我要买。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Helper]
Thank you very much~!
Please remember, you
should use this with your
partner in a place that is
special to the both of you.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
非常感谢~！
请记住，你应该和你的伴侣在你们俩都特别的地方使用它。

scripts.text:
[Helper]
'Sweet Memory of Marriage' is 50,000 zeny. But don't seem to have enough money with you right now. Maybe you and your partner could help each other to buy the Sweet Memory of Marriage?
scripts.translation:
[助手]
‘甜蜜婚姻记忆’售价50,000泽尼。但你现在似乎没有足够的钱。也许你和你的伴侣可以互相帮助购买‘甜蜜婚姻记忆’？

scripts.text:
[Helper]
Even if your relationship ends,
the memories the both of you have shared will remain forever...
scripts.translation:
[助手]
即使你们的关系结束，你们共同拥有的回忆将永远留存……

scripts.text:
[Employee Tryteh]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~
Anyway, I am so glad that you two have gotten married. I hope you both will live happily ever after~
scripts.translation:
[员工 特莱泰]
欢迎来到爪哇酒馆~
总之，我很高兴你们俩结婚了。希望你们从此幸福地生活在一起~

scripts.text:
[Employee Tryteh]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~
I hope you enjoy your stay
over here. But try not
to drink too much~
scripts.translation:
[员工 特莱泰]
欢迎来到爪哇酒馆~
希望你在这里过得愉快。但尽量不要喝太多~

scripts.text:
[Employee Tryteh]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~
I hope you will have a good time.
scripts.translation:
[员工 特莱泰]
欢迎来到爪哇酒馆~
希望你玩得开心。

scripts.text:
[Employee Tryteh]
Try to be a little careful if you bump into any rude customers.
They might be drunk and do something stupid. You know
how it is...
scripts.translation:
[员工 特莱泰]
如果遇到粗鲁的顾客，请小心一点。
他们可能喝醉了，会做蠢事。你知道的……

scripts.text:
[Employee Fey]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~
scripts.translation:
[员工 菲伊]
欢迎来到爪哇酒馆~

scripts.text:
[Employee Fey]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~
Have a good time! But please,
try not to interrupt the happily married people here!
scripts.translation:
[员工 菲伊]
欢迎来到爪哇酒馆~
玩得开心！但请不要打扰这里幸福的新婚夫妇！

scripts.text:
[Employee Fey]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~
I hope you will have a good time~
scripts.translation:
[员工 菲伊]
欢迎来到爪哇酒馆~
希望你玩得开心~

scripts.text:
[Employee Fey]
We hope that you enjoy your time here with the one that you love. Isn't this place nice and cozy,
a perfect romantic atmosphere?
scripts.translation:
[员工 菲伊]
我们希望你能和你爱的人在这里度过美好时光。这个地方温馨舒适，充满浪漫氛围，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Employee Fey]
It would be absolutely perfect if it weren't for those 'Invincible Single Army' weirdos. Somehow,
a few of those dorks found their way here. To hell with them!
scripts.translation:
[员工 菲伊]
如果没有那些‘无敌单身军团’的怪人，那就完美了。不知怎么的，有几个呆子找到了这里。去他们的！

scripts.text:
[Employee Buffy]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~
scripts.translation:
[员工 巴菲]
欢迎来到爪哇酒馆~

scripts.text:
[Employee Buffy]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~
I hope you will have a good time.
scripts.translation:
[员工 巴菲]
欢迎来到爪哇酒馆~
希望你玩得开心。

scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊啊啊啊~！
这酒真好喝！

scripts.text:
This is for one who wants to relive wild, youthful days, honor those who have fought for justice and liberty, or just to drink alcohol until they vomit stomach acid.
for one who wants to remember people fighting for liberty...
scripts.translation:
这是给那些想要重温狂野青春岁月、纪念为正义和自由而战的人，或者只是想喝酒直到吐出胃酸的人准备的。
给那些想要记住为自由而战的人……

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou receive a tumbler filled with brown liquid. It a has a very thick, machine like smell. It kind of reminds you of gunpowder.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你收到一个装满棕色液体的平底杯。它有一种非常浓重的机器般的味道。有点像火药的味道。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
It might look too big to drink at once, but I suggest that you finish it in one gulp. If you drink it slowly, you'll pass out.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
它看起来太大，不能一口喝完，但我建议你一口干掉。如果你慢慢喝，你会晕倒。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou firmly grabbed
the tumbler and
gulped it down.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你紧紧抓住
平底杯，
一饮而尽。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou feel pretty hammered.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你感觉有点醉了。^000000

scripts.text: There are not many people who like this drink. But the ones that do like this drink, love it.
scripts.translation: 喜欢这种饮料的人不多。但喜欢的人，非常喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
Although it has a beautiful, appetizing color, its appearance can be misleading. Most people feel cold and empty after having some
of this.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
虽然它有美丽诱人的颜色，但其外观具有误导性。大多数人喝完后会感到寒冷和空虚。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou receive a crooked glass
filled with purple fluid. Although it smells pleasant, you have a strange feeling of disgust as you draw it closer to your face.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你收到一个歪歪扭扭的玻璃杯，里面装着紫色液体。虽然闻起来很香，但当你把它靠近脸时，你有一种奇怪的厌恶感。

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
If you don't want to drink it, tell me now. But it might be good to try it once, just to experience it.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
如果你不想喝，现在就告诉我。但尝试一次体验一下也不错。

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou took a sip of it and sighed.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你抿了一口，叹了口气。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFAnd promised yourself that you would never drink it ever again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF并告诉自己再也不喝它了。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Master...
One more please...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
师父……
请再来一杯……

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
It's on me.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
算我的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you...
Mr. Bartender...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
谢谢……
调酒师先生……

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
There you go.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
给你。

scripts.text: [Bartender]
scripts.translation: [调酒师]

scripts.text:
[Buchi]
Grrrr...
Damn! I don't
like this place!
I don't like this at all!
scripts.translation:
[布奇]
咕噜噜……
该死！我不
喜欢这个地方！
我一点也不喜欢！

scripts.text:
[Buchi]
Hey, why aren't you drinking?
I guess you're all out of dough.
But I know how you feel. Disgusted with all the lovey dovey around this place, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[布奇]
嘿，你为什么不喝？
我猜你没钱了。
但我知道你的感受。讨厌这里到处卿卿我我的氛围，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Buchi]
You look happy...
I hope you'll be
able to feel that
way forever...
 
^666666*Hiccup...!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[布奇]
你看起来很开心……
我希望你能
永远保持
这种感觉……
 
^666666*打嗝...!*^000000

scripts.text:
[Buchi]
I can't believe my eyes! Everyone else looks disgustingly happy! It makes me feel so miserable!
You agree, don't you?!
scripts.translation:
[布奇]
我简直不敢相信我的眼睛！其他人看起来都恶心地开心！这让我感觉很悲惨！
你同意，对吧？！

scripts.text:
[Buchi]
Grrrr...
Bartender!
Give me one more!
scripts.translation:
[布奇]
咕噜噜……
调酒师！
再给我一杯！

scripts.text:
[Buchi]
Heh.
Lemme buy
you a drink!
scripts.translation:
[布奇]
嘿。
让我请你
喝一杯！

scripts.text:
[Buchi]
Drink this at once, and forget about your miserable life! Cheer up, you got the whole future ahead of you and a drink in front of you! Come on, now~!
scripts.translation:
[布奇]
马上喝掉这个，忘掉你悲惨的生活！振作起来，你有整个未来在你面前，还有一杯酒在你面前！来吧，现在~！

scripts.text: ^3355FFHe ordered a JJ special for me.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF他为我点了一杯JJ特调。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Damn...!
Damn! I will be
the one who laughs last!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
该死……！
该死！我会是
笑到最后的人！

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou drank to your fill.^000000

[Cage]
....Bah!
What are you so happy about?
After all, everyone knows marriage is a sham for desperate, lonely people!
scripts.translation:
[凯奇]
....呸！
你这么高兴干什么？
毕竟，大家都知道婚姻是绝望、孤独者的骗局！

scripts.text:
[Cage]
Drink, drink...!!
Eat, eat...!!
Join me,
my brother
in singlehood!
scripts.translation:
[凯奇]
喝，喝……！！
吃，吃……！！
加入我，
我的单身
兄弟！

scripts.text:
[Cage]
I don't trust anybody!
You're a fool for chaining
yourself to some gorgeous
woman for life!
You hear me?!
A FOOL!
scripts.translation:
[凯奇]
我不信任任何人！
你把自己拴在一个漂亮
女人身边一辈子是个傻瓜！
听到了吗？！
傻瓜！

scripts.text:
[Cage]
Look at you!
You're a fool for
chaining yourself to
some pretty boy for life!
You hear me?! A FOOL!
scripts.translation:
[凯奇]
看看你！
你把自己拴在一个
帅哥身边一辈子是个傻瓜！
听到了吗？！傻瓜！

scripts.text:
[Cage]
The single life is
what it's all about!
Women may break my
spirit, but they'll never take...
MY FREEDOM!
scripts.translation:
[凯奇]
单身生活才是
一切！
女人可能会摧毁我的
精神，但她们永远夺不走……
我的自由！

scripts.text:
[Cage]
We are free...!
We are free from
the hell of marriage...!
We are the sincere and
competent singles...!
scripts.translation:
[凯奇]
我们是自由的……！
我们从婚姻的
地狱中解脱了……！
我们是真诚且
能干的单身人士……！

Hey, you...!
You understand, don't you?!
Aren't you upset looking at all these happily married couples?!
Yeah~? Me too!
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
嘿，你……！
你明白的，对吧？！
看着这些幸福的新婚夫妇，你不生气吗？！
是啊~？我也是！

scripts.text:
[SoloHan]
How dare they show off their happiness in front of people like us--!! ^666666*Sniff*^000000 Just because they found everlasting love, they think they're better than we are?!
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
他们怎么敢在我们这种人面前炫耀他们的幸福--！！ ^666666*抽泣*^000000 就因为他们找到了永恒的爱，他们就觉得自己比我们强？！

scripts.text:
[SoloHan]
I remember when couples were polite and were lovey dovey behind closed doors. Nowadays they hold hands, and even cuddle in public. I mean, come on! Get a room!
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
我记得以前情侣们都很礼貌，只在私下里卿卿我我。现在他们牵手，甚至在公共场合拥抱。我是说，拜托！开个房间吧！

scripts.text:
[SoloHan]
I mean, ^666666*Sniff*^000000, it's not like,
I'm lonely or anything. I don't neeeeeeeed a woman~!
Right, Bachewcca!
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
我是说，^666666*抽泣*^000000，我不是，
我很孤独什么的。我不需~~~~要女人~！
对吧，巴切卡！

scripts.text:
[Bachewcca]
...!

[SoloHan]
It's doesn't really matter whether you're married
or not, right buddy? Right?!
Come on! Drink with me!!
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
结不结婚其实不重要，对吧伙计？对吧？！
来吧！跟我一起喝！！

scripts.text:
^3355FFSuddenly he treated me as a close friend. It's a little embarrassing, but it's not a bad idea to accept
a free drink...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF突然他把我当成了密友。有点尴尬，但接受免费饮料也不是坏主意……^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FF* Gulp Gulp Gulp *^000000

Let's go somewhere
with some real liquor.

scripts.text: ...One more drink.
scripts.translation: ……再来一杯。

scripts.text: ...What kind of place is it?
scripts.translation: ……是什么样的地方？

scripts.text:

Yeah~!

Hey, Bachewcca...
Let's drink!
scripts.translation:

是啊~！

一起喝！

scripts.text:

To...

scripts.translation:

[独行汉]

多喝点，伙计！

scripts.text:
[SoloHan]
I guess now's the perfect time to have you sign this! Don't worry, I'll send you straight to paradise!
scripts.translation:

我想现在是让你签这个的完美时机！别担心，我会直接送你去天堂！

Take care!

好吧！

哈哈哈！

scripts.text:

Man.

scripts.translation:

保重，玩得开心！

scripts.text:

...Wha!?
Oh man!
Get outta my face!
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]

哦天！
滚出我的视线！

scripts.text:
[SoloHan]
...Wha!?
Oh man!
Get outta my face!
You smell like,
whupped boyfriend
or something!
scripts.translation:

被甩的男朋友
什么的！

scripts.text:
[SoloHan]
I think I know a naggy wife
when I see one! Go boss your
hubby around or something!
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
我看出来你是个唠叨的妻子！去管管你老公什么的！

scripts.text:
[SoloHan]
Leave me alone!
I don't want any of your marital bliss to rub off on me. Come on, Bachewcca! Tell 'em their kind ain't welcome here!
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
别烦我！
我不想沾上你们的婚姻幸福。来吧，巴切卡！告诉他们这里不欢迎他们这种人！

scripts.text:
[SoloHan]
What is that...?
Is this the third time this week I've gotten plastered? Bachewcca, help me count!
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
那是什么……？
这是我本周第三次喝醉了吗？巴切卡，帮我数数！

..............
^666666*Gulp....gulp...*^000000

[Helper]
Newlyweds and
long time couples...
We invite you to Jawaii,
the honeymoon resort!
scripts.translation:
[助手]
新婚夫妇和
长久伴侣……
我们邀请你们来到爪哇，
蜜月度假胜地！

scripts.text: Jawaii?
scripts.translation: 爪哇？

scripts.text: Let's go to Jawaii~!
scripts.translation: 我们去爪哇吧~！

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消。

scripts.text:
[Helper]
There is an island far, far away from the Midgard continent.
It is a very quiet and beautiful island resort that only opens
its doors to couples.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
在米德加尔特大陆很远很远的地方有一个岛屿。
那是一个只向情侣开放的非常安静美丽的岛屿度假村。

scripts.text:
[Helper]
This is an exclusive travel offer to the special honeymoon resort for Midgard's citizens. The price, 100,000 zeny, may be expensive, but you really get what you pay for.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
这是专为米德加尔特市民提供的特殊蜜月度假村旅行优惠。价格100,000泽尼可能有点贵，但你绝对物有所值。

scripts.text:
[Helper]
I guarantee you that some of
the happiest moments you can
experience in your marriage will be on this island. Can you really put a price on that?
scripts.translation:
[助手]
我保证你在婚姻中能体验到的一些最快乐的时刻将在这个岛上度过。你真的能给这定价吗？

scripts.text:
[Helper]
Errm...
Unfortunately, singles are not allowed on the island. Why don't you go forget your loneliness in the Prontera pub?
scripts.translation:
[助手]
呃……
不幸的是，单身人士不允许上岛。你为什么不去普隆德拉的酒吧忘记你的孤独呢？

scripts.text:
[Helper]
Bon Voyage...!!
Let me guide
you to 'Jawaii!'
scripts.translation:
[助手]
一路顺风……！！
让我带你
去‘爪哇’！

scripts.text:
[Helper]
As I explained, you must have 100,000 zeny in order to visit Jawaii. Why don't you ask your partner for help in gathering the zeny for this trip?
scripts.translation:
[助手]
如我所解释，你需要有100,000泽尼才能访问爪哇。为什么不请你的伴侣帮忙筹集这次旅行的泽尼呢？

scripts.text:
[Helper]
There's there no better way to share special, secluded moments with your beloved than through
a secret trip to a remote, exotic area.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
没有比通过秘密前往偏远异国情调的地区与你心爱的人分享特殊、隐蔽的时刻更好的方式了。

scripts.text:
[Helper]
A vacation in Jawaii could very well be the greatest gift that you could give to the one you love~
scripts.translation:
[助手]
爪哇的假期很可能是你能送给你爱人的最棒的礼物~
